name: CIE Automotive India Limited
summary: CIE Automotive India Limited produces and sells automotive components to original equipment manufacturers and other customers in India, Europe, and internationally. It offers forgings, such as crankshafts, CV joints, knuckles, diff Casw, and spindles; gears, including gears and shafts, e-drive components, flanges/end yokes, and clutch hubs; composites comprising front lid, wind shield-electric-3WH, electric box top tray, and front bumper; and crankcase, pump housing, and brake panel aluminum products. The company also provides iron castings, such as differential, turbine, and axle housings, as well as gear carriers; hard and soft magnets; and stampings, including chassis and structural parts…
